test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 3 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In one-sixth of the time that B takes to complete a piece of work, A can complete half of the same work. If working together they take 16 days to complete the work, how much time shall B take to complete it alone?
solution:
**GIVEN:**

A and B together complete work in = 16 days

**FORMULA USED:**

Efficiency = Total work / No. of days.

**CALCULATION:**

B × 1/2 = A × 1/6 

⇒ A = 3B 

⇒ Aover B = 3 over1 

⇒A's efficiency = 3 unit /day

and B's efficiency = 1 unit/day

⇒ According, to the Question

( A+ B) complete in 16 days

⇒ Total work = ( 3+1) × 16 = 4 × 16 = 64.

⇒ Time taken by B = 64over 1 = 64 days 

**Hence, B alone takes 64 days to complete the work.**
